questions.question: You’re at a party and someone spills their drink on your new shirt. What would be the most appropriate response if you wanted to apologise and offer help?
options: Don’t worry about it, it’s fine!
I’m so sorry about that—can I get you some tissues?
That’s okay, it’s not my fault.
I’ll buy you a new shirt instead.
questions.answer: I’m so sorry about that—can I get you some tissues?

questions.question: Your friend says, ‘I think we should move this meeting to the afternoon.’ What would be the best way to suggest an alternative time if you’re busy?
options: No, let’s stick to the original time.
That’s a good idea! What about tomorrow instead?
I don’t like that plan.
I’ll check my calendar and get back to you.
questions.answer: That’s a good idea! What about tomorrow instead?

questions.question: At a formal dinner, your neighbour disagrees with your opinion about a book. How would you respond politely if you wanted to agree but also show understanding?
options: I disagree completely—it’s terrible!
I see your point, but I still think it’s overrated.
That’s a different perspective, but I love it!
You’re wrong; this book is boring.
questions.answer: I see your point, but I still think it’s overrated.

questions.question: A colleague asks you to help with a project you’re not sure about. What would be the most appropriate way to politely decline and offer an alternative?
options: Sure, I’ll help—just let me know what you need.
I’m sorry, I can’t take on more right now, but I can help with [specific task] instead.
No, I don’t want to work with you.
This isn’t my area of expertise, but I’ll do what I can.
questions.answer: I’m sorry, I can’t take on more right now, but I can help with [specific task] instead.

questions.question: Your boss asks you to present at the next team meeting. What would be the best way to express your enthusiasm while also asking for clarification on the details?
options: I’ll do it, but I’m not sure I know enough about the topic.
That sounds great! Can you remind me of the key points to include?
I’d rather not—it’s too much work.
I’ll prepare something, but I’m not confident.
questions.answer: That sounds great! Can you remind me of the key points to include?
